text:
Maya Ramos: Planning SolaceGrid dedicated rollout for customer 'SolaceGrid' tonight 23:30 UTC. Aim: model pin + small canary then traffic shift. Need go/no-go + KMS overlap check. Pin request: model=solace-v2.14.3, runtime=redwood-runtime-3.1. Can we lock this?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: sol-grid/dedicated v2.14.3 -> production (slice s1) at 2024-11-05T23:30:00Z. /deploy status: queued :robot_face:

Raj Patel: Quick qs — what's the rollback play and canary plan? Also confirm SLOs we should watch.

Lin Huang: Pin confirmed: model=solace-v2.14.3-quant, runtime=redwood-runtime-3.1. Rollback command (ops):
```
# rollback to previous model release
redwood rollout --customer solacegrid --target-version v2.14.2 --stage immediate
```
Canary config: slice s1 = 10% for 30m, monitor window 5m, auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.5% or p50 latency > 120ms for 2 consecutive windows.

Sofia Morales: Heads-up from CS — customer has a scheduled KMS key rotation at 23:45 UTC. They asked about doing it as planned. That would collide with our traffic shift. @Tessa can we ask them to postpone 30m? They require zero downtime.

Tessa Klein: Pinged customer legal/ops. Waiting on explicit postponement. I asked to move KMS rotation to 00:15 UTC. If they confirm, we can keep 23:30 start.

Omar Idris: If KMS rotates mid-deploy we could see auth failures on newly started workers until keys re-propagate. Recommendation: if rotation falls within ±30m of traffic shift, delay traffic shift. Canary still safe if we avoid initiating new auth-sensitive slices during rotation.

Carl Ng: Oncall here — I'll be online 22:45-01:00. I'll watch alerts and be ready to trigger rollback. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/solacegrid-dedicated-deploy> (ops steps and pager contacts).

Lin Huang: Also adding a preflight smoke step: 5 warmup requests to populate KV cache and validate token signing. Command snippet:
```
redwood smoke --customer solacegrid --slice s1 --requests 5
```

Maya Ramos: Plan B if customer won't postpone KMS: start canary at 23:30 but hold traffic shift. We only move traffic after KMS is complete + 15m stability window. Decision: wait for customer confirmation or we push to 00:30 UTC.

Raj Patel: Acknowledged. I'll watch p50/p95, error rate, and auth failure logs. If auth errors spike > 0.2% during canary, we stop and rollback.

Sofia Morales: Customer replied: can postpone rotation to 00:10 UTC, asks if we can shift to 23:50 start. Tessa confirms SLA ok with that.

Maya Ramos: OK new target 23:50 UTC start (canary 10% for 30m). Traffic shift earliest 00:40 UTC after KMS rotation and stability. Approvals needed: @Raj Patel, @Lin Huang, @Carl Ng, @Sofia Morales. React with :white_check_mark: to approve.

Raj Patel: ✅

Lin Huang: ✅

Carl Ng: ✅

Sofia Morales: ✅ (CS confirmed with customer)

Maya Ramos: Great — locking pins and updating deploybot schedule. I'll post final release note in #eng-releases 30m before start. If anything changes, call pager. :rocket:
